apply.eligibilityExceptionLead: These questions do not automatically accept or deny you. If you're between situations, slightly over the threshold, or unsure how to answer, continue anyway — we review real-life circumstances individually, consistent with our

home.title: Career Training & Industry Certificates
home.description: Occupational and career training with Workforce Funded Training access for qualified members — Digital Literacy, Tech, Data, AI, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and Skilled Trades. Apply today.
home.heroCopy: Career training through Workforce Funded Training for qualified members. Earn industry-recognized credentials — IBM, Google, Microsoft, AWS, CompTIA, plus manufacturing and logistics certs (CPT, CLT). Start with Find Your Path, see programs that fit, and get counselor guidance, resume help, and job-search support.
home.trustReviewedDetail: Applications are reviewed by WorkforceAP staff, with next-step follow-up in 1 to 2 business days.
home.trustYears: Built on 25+ years of workforce experience
home.trustYearsDetail: WorkforceAP is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit built in Austin on 25+ years of workforce development experience across public, nonprofit, and employer-serving organizations.
home.trustEmployerDetail: Training includes certificate tracks and tools tied to employers, hiring pathways, and real job support.
home.readyToApply: Ready to apply? Start your application →
home.heroBody1: Workforce Advancement Project (WorkforceAP) is a 501c3 nonprofit that equips individuals, counselors, and community advisors with workforce readiness tools, occupational training and professional certificates, and AI-powered resume, interview and job placement assistance to help secure meaningful employment and build lasting careers and a better life for qualified members through Workforce Funded Training.
home.heroBody2: Start your application in about two minutes, or take the quick 3-question quiz to explore programs — then get clear next steps from a real team.
home.heroStep2: See programs that match your goals
home.heroStep3: Get counselor follow-up and job support

home.aboutTitle: Employer-Aligned Training. Career Support Throughout the Journey.
home.aboutBody1: WorkforceAP is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit built in Austin on 25+ years of workforce development experience and a recurring Vision given to Michael Brown by God for serving His people. WorkforceAP combines employer-aligned training, AI workforce readiness and soft-skill support, occupational training, and career guidance in a model built to work and scale — through Workforce Funded Training for qualified members.
home.aboutBody2: Our leadership brings experience from the Texas Workforce Commission, Workforce Solutions, the City of Austin, ReWork America Alliance, Consulting Solutions.Net, Goodwill Central Texas, Austin Area Urban League, Apprentice Now, Austin Urban Technology Movement, Universal Tech Movement, and African American Youth Harvest Foundation. Through grants and partner-backed pathways, we support members with resume help, interview prep, job-search guidance, and career support from first step to placement.
home.journeySubtitle: Wherever you're starting from, you belong here. We've grouped what we do into three simple phases so nothing feels like a maze — just people and a plan beside you.
home.journeySupportLine: Our team walks with you at every step.
home.journeyPhasesRibbon: Get Started → Train → Launch Your Career
home.programsSubtitle: Career training that prepares you for jobs employers are hiring for right now.
home.aiTitle: Resume Feedback in Minutes, Not Days
home.aiCopy: Members get AI tools that sharpen your resume, build your elevator speech, practice interviews with questions specific to your target role, and track progress inside the member portal.
home.ctaCopy: About 10 minutes to apply. We respond within 1–2 business days. Industry-recognized certificates and placement support. No-cost for qualifying members.
home.contrast1: Job boards list openings — we train you for them
home.contrast2: Bootcamps charge tuition — we're funded by grants and partners, no cost to you
home.contrast3: College takes years — our certificates take months

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Your path from application through certification and job placement — organized into three phases so you always know what we're focusing on together.
howItWorks.heroCopy: No gatekeeping. Clear, Workforce Funded Training pathways for qualifying members. Just a guided process — from your first conversation with us to your first day on the job (and beyond).
howItWorks.whoCanApplyBody: WorkforceAP is designed for adults who face barriers to employment — including low-income individuals, people with employment gaps, those with limited or no formal work history, justice-involved individuals, dislocated workers, veterans, and adult learners seeking a career change. WIOA eligibility can unlock additional funding.
howItWorks.journeySubtitle: Three phases — get oriented, train and earn credentials, then move into work with people beside you the whole way.
howItWorks.videoCaption: Prefer to read? The summary below is always available.
howItWorks.laptopBody: Access to technology shouldn't be a barrier to education. We provide high-performance laptops to members who need them for the duration of their training program.
howItWorks.laptopItem3: No upfront program cost for qualifying members
howItWorks.support150Body: We don't just find you a job; we help you keep it. Our support continues for five months after your start date.
howItWorks.training1Desc: Approved certification tracks and technical bootcamps are funded through grants and partnerships.
howItWorks.training2Desc: Access to an exclusive community of members and alumni for mentorship and networking.
howItWorks.training3Desc: Support connecting to openings shared through our employer network and placement efforts.
howItWorks.training4Desc: Dedicated sessions on leadership, communication, and emotional intelligence.
howItWorks.ctaTitle: Ready to take the first step?
howItWorks.ctaBody: The application takes about ten minutes. It's a conversation, not an exam — and there's no application fee.

leadership.title: Board & Leadership
leadership.description: Meet the leadership team behind WorkforceAP — decades of workforce experience, employer-side tech credibility, military discipline, and nationwide community impact.
leadership.governanceBody: Our governance team combines decades of workforce development leadership, employer-side tech credibility, military and operations discipline, and deep community roots — connecting workforce training to real outcomes across the nation.
leadership.quote: This isn't a generic nonprofit team. These are people who've run programs at scale, led at Goodwill and Urban League, built systems at IBM and Microsoft, commanded in the Army and at AWS — and who show up nationwide.

programs.heroDesc: Explore career training programs offered through Workforce Funded Training for qualified members, with certifications from IBM, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and CompTIA.
programs.quickStartBody: Start with the lane that fits you best.
programs.cardSalaryDisclaimer: Salary range is Austin market estimate (Lightcast/BLS, Jan 2026). Actual pay depends on experience and employer.
programs.journeyIntro: WorkforceAP supports members at every step, from choosing a program to landing a job in your field.
programs.journeyStep1Desc: Use the pathfinder to align your interests, timeline, and goals with the right program.
programs.journeyStep2Desc: Complete training at your own pace or in cohort and earn an industry-recognized certificate.
programs.journeyStep3Desc: Resume review, mock interviews, and practical prep for the roles you're targeting.
programs.journeyStep4Desc: Direct introductions to our network of employer partners actively hiring program completers.
programs.howToChooseDesc: Pick what fits your life: your current skills, how much time you have, and the kind of work you want.
programs.howToChooseFactor1Desc: What work feels natural or exciting to you?
programs.howToChooseFactor2Desc: Some programs work on phones; others need a laptop.
programs.howToChooseFactor3Desc: Most programs need 5–10 hours per week for 3–5 months.
programs.howToChooseFactor4Desc: Entry-level roles start around $35K–$55K in Austin.
programs.howToChooseFactor5Desc: Some certificates lead directly to jobs; others are stepping stones.
programs.howToChooseFootnoteLink: The pathfinder guide helps in about two minutes.
programs.quickStartCard1Desc: Build confidence with computers, email, and online tools.
programs.quickStartCard2Desc: Learn troubleshooting, networking, and security basics.
programs.quickStartCard3Desc: Code, deploy, and debug real applications.
programs.ctaSubheadline: Apply in minutes. A member advisor will follow up within 1–2 business days.

faq.heroCopy: Answers that address your concerns, whether you're applying, supporting someone who is, or deciding if WorkforceAP is right for you.
faq.quickAnswersTitle: Start with the questions people ask most.
faq.faq1q: How much do WorkforceAP programs cost?
faq.faq1a: Programs are offered through Workforce Funded Training for qualified members. WorkforceAP helps you understand the funding path, eligibility, and next step before you commit.
faq.faq2q: Do I need prior tech experience?
faq.faq2a: No. Many members start from zero. If computers still feel new, there are beginner-safe options designed to help you build confidence first.
faq.faq3a: WorkforceAP reviews your goals, confirms fit, and follows up with next steps. That can include intake guidance, documentation review, or program-specific support.
faq.faq4a: Most programs take about 3–5 months at roughly 10 hours per week. Digital Literacy is shorter and works well as an on-ramp if you need a gentler start.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: Contact Workforce Advancement Project for program questions, enrollment support, and partnership opportunities.
contact.heroCopy: Whether you're a current or prospective member with program questions, an employer looking to hire or build a pipeline, a community partner exploring a referral relationship, or a donor interested in supporting Workforce Funded Training, reach out and a WorkforceAP team member will respond within 1–2 business days.
contact.card4Body: We reply within 1–2 business days for most inquiries.
contact.austinTitle: Built in Austin, supporting members nationwide
contact.austinBody: We work from Austin, Texas and support members, partners, and employers across the country. Use the form, email, or phone to reach the right WorkforceAP team member. We coordinate with partner organizations, but counselors and partner organizations are not the same thing.
contact.quote: We believe everyone deserves a clear path to a meaningful career. That starts with being available and responsive to the people we serve.

partners.title: Community & Employer Partners
partners.description: Partner with WorkforceAP: employers hire talent, referral orgs send candidates, workforce boards align, funders support scale. Clear next steps for each.
partners.heroCopy: Community partners refer the people we serve; referral partners share in placement outcomes when funding is available. Training centers, public agencies, and funders each have a clear path too.
partners.referralPayMicrocopy: Referral partners receive a stipend per verified placement, paid only after the placement is verified and the relevant grant or partner funding has cleared. Community partners do not receive payouts. No cost to members; partners refer only, never sell.
partners.narrativeQuote: We partner with employers who hire, orgs who refer, workforce boards who align, and funders who scale. Each partnership type has a clear path — because building a skilled workforce takes all of us working together.
partners.narrativeCopy: Referral partners send us candidates who may benefit from career training offered through Workforce Funded Training for qualified members. We reach out within 24–48 hours and walk them through the process. We welcome referrals of individuals motivated to improve the quality of their life and interested in training in technology, healthcare, manufacturing, or skilled trades.
partners.narrativeLi1: Submit a referral via our contact form or partner portal
partners.narrativeLi2: We contact the candidate within 24–48 hours
partners.narrativeLi3: Accepted members receive training, certificates, and job placement support
partners.narrativeLi4: You receive updates when referred individuals complete programs
partners.ctaCopy: Clear next steps, real outcomes, and a team that follows up within 1–2 business days.
partners.signupSubtitle: Refer members, track outcomes, get paid. Submit the form — we activate your partner portal within 1–2 business days.
partners.signupOtherPaths: Training centers, public agencies, and funders:
partners.signupContactTeam: contact us for the right path
partners.referralWho: Nonprofits, social services, churches, reentry programs, community centers, workforce centers, federal one-stop centers.
partners.referralWhy: Refer clients who need career training. We follow up within 1-2 business days. There is no cost to refer. You get updates when referred individuals complete programs.
partners.trainingWho: Educational institutions, community colleges, vocational schools, digital literacy centers.
partners.trainingWhy: Co-deliver employer-recognized certification programs. We bring the employer pipeline; you bring the learning environment.
partners.agencyWho: Workforce Solutions, TWC, WIOA providers, government workforce programs.
partners.agencyWhy: Align your participants with employer-recognized in-demand certifications. We handle training and placement; you strengthen outcomes for your population.
partners.funderWho: Foundations, corporate giving, impact investors, individual donors.
partners.funderWhy: Fund a model that works. Employer-aligned training, no participant debt, measurable job outcomes. We're growing nationwide and building toward national scale.
partners.platformFeature1Desc: Structured enrollment and eligibility screening reduces onboarding time by 60%, letting counselors focus on high-touch support.
partners.platformFeature2Desc: Partners access live data on referral status, enrollment progress, certification completions, and placement outcomes.
partners.platformFeature3Desc: Automated credential verification and WIOA-compliant reporting ensures accountability across every partnership.
partners.faq1a: Employers, workforce development boards, non-profit services, churches, community organizations, social service agencies, and educational institutions can partner with WorkforceAP to refer candidates or hire graduates.
partners.faq2q: Is there a cost to refer candidates?
partners.faq2a: No. There is no cost to refer someone. We welcome partners who want to connect individuals in their network with our career training programs offered through Workforce Funded Training for qualified members.
partners.faq3a: Use the referral partner registration form on this page to get a partner portal and referral link. You can also email info@workforceap.org or call (512) 777-1808 with the candidate's name and contact information.
partners.faq4a: Yes. We actively connect employers with job-ready graduates. Reach out to discuss your hiring needs and we can share candidate profiles and schedule introductions.
partners.faq5a: Partners receive regular updates on referral status, program completion rates, and placement outcomes. Our digital platform provides real-time dashboards for tracking progress.

employers.title: Hire Certified Tech Graduates
employers.description: Access pre-screened, certified tech talent. WorkforceAP graduates hold industry credentials from Google, IBM, AWS, CompTIA. Post jobs or become a hiring partner. Serving employers nationwide.
employers.waitlistCopy: We're focused on placing our first cohort right now. Hire-now applications are welcome below — we'll match you with certified candidates as they finish their programs. Hiring volume scales over the next two cohorts.
employers.heroCopy: Start the employer intake with your hiring use case, role needs, volume, and timeline. We will route you to the right partnership path and follow up with matched talent options.
employers.valueCard1Desc: Members complete training and are vetted through the Workforce Advancement Project process — with industry credentials from Google, IBM, Microsoft, AWS, CompTIA.
employers.valueCard2Desc: Access talent from underserved communities, adult learners, and veterans — bringing fresh perspectives and resilience to your teams.
employers.valueCard3Desc: 150-day onboarding support for every hire. We help your new team members succeed long-term, not just on day one.
employers.valueCard4Desc: Customized training pathways designed in partnership with employers to ensure curriculum aligns with specific organizational needs.
employers.processStep1Desc: Add your job to our employer portal. We match it to our pipeline.
employers.processStep2Desc: Receive pre-screened applicants who hold relevant certifications.
employers.processStep3Desc: You conduct interviews and make the hire on your timeline.
employers.processStep4Desc: We support your new hire's onboarding for long-term success.
employers.tierStandardF2: Access to active members and alumni

employers.introStep1Desc: Tell us what you need — or browse our pipeline of trained, job-ready candidates.
employers.introStep2Desc: Our team connects you with vetted graduates whose skills align with your requirements.
employers.introStep3Desc: Interview on your timeline with support from our team when you need it.

impact.title: Our Impact
impact.description: See how Workforce Advancement Project expands access to career training through employer-aligned programs, partnerships, and member support.
impact.heading: Workforce development built for
impact.intro: Workforce Advancement Project helps people move into stronger career paths through Workforce Funded Training, employer-informed program design, and wraparound support that keeps momentum moving after enrollment.
impact.stat1Label: Years removing barriers to workforce opportunity
impact.stat2Label: Learners trained through workforce development programs (historical)
impact.stat3Label: Career tracks aligned to real employer demand
impact.stat4Label: Cost to members — Workforce Funded Training
impact.modelDesc: Employer partnerships and public funding help cover program access, support services, and workforce readiness so members can focus on learning and placement.
impact.membersDesc: Career-aligned training, recognized certificates, structured guidance, and support with applications, resumes, and employer introductions when timing is right.
impact.whyDesc: The goal is not just course completion. It is durable movement toward employment, higher earnings, and clearer next steps for the people and communities WorkforceAP serves.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.description: Read Workforce Advancement Project accessibility commitments and how to request help using the site.
accessibility.heading: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Workforce Advancement Project works to make this site easier to use for members, partners, employers, and community supporters. We aim to provide clear content, readable layouts, keyboard-usable navigation, and mobile-friendly access on slow devices and limited connections.
accessibility.helpTitle: If you need help using this site
accessibility.helpCopy: If you run into a barrier while using WorkforceAP.org, contact us and we will do our best to provide the information or support you need in another format.
accessibility.improvementsCopy1: We continue improving content clarity, color contrast, tap targets, and responsive behavior across public and member-facing pages.
accessibility.improvementsCopy2: If something is hard to read, navigate, or complete, please tell us. That feedback helps us improve access for the people this work is meant to serve.

mentor.title: Become a Mentor
mentor.description: Volunteer your expertise to help job-seekers advance their careers. Log hours, earn a tax deduction letter, and give back to your community.
mentor.waitlistCopy: We're accepting mentor applications now and matching as our cohort grows. Most pairings start 4–8 weeks after you apply, when a member reaches the interview-prep stage of their program in your domain.
mentor.heroHeadline: Share Your Expertise. Change a Career.
mentor.heroSubheadline: WorkforceAP mentors are industry professionals who volunteer their time to guide job-seekers. Your experience is worth more than you think — and it's tax-deductible.
mentor.benefit1Desc: Every session is recorded. We track your total volunteer hours so you never have to.
mentor.benefit2Desc: Download a nonprofit volunteer hour letter for your tax filings — generated automatically from your session history.
mentor.benefit3Desc: Your guidance helps adults overcome barriers to employment — career changers, veterans, returning workers.
mentor.benefit4Desc: Connect with motivated professionals who are eager to learn and grow. Many mentors find their next hires here.
